description: Python CLI and library for auditing HTTP security headers against configurable YAML rulesets. OWASP ASVS V14 preset, CSP nonce/hash intelligence, CORS misconfiguration detection, cookie validation.
rules: Header names are case-insensitive (uses CaseInsensitiveDict internally)
Use Drheader(url=...) to scan a remote endpoint, Drheader(headers={...}) for pre-captured headers
Default HTTP method is HEAD; pass method='POST' to change
Cross-origin isolation checks (COEP/COOP) require explicit cross_origin_isolated=True flag
CORS origin reflection probe only runs in scan mode (URL), not compare mode (local headers)
analyze() returns list[Finding]; use finding.to_dict() for JSON-serializable output
Custom rules: load_rules(rules_file=f) or load_rules(rules_uri=url, merge_default=True)
Preset rules: preset_rules('owasp-asvs-v14') -- cannot combine with custom rules files
Finding is a dataclass (rule, message, severity, value, expected, avoid, anomalies, delimiter) — NOT a dict
Empty findings list means all headers passed validation; non-empty means violations found
CLI exit code is non-zero when findings exist — use this to fail CI/CD pipelines
Three rule loaders: default_rules() for built-in, preset_rules(name) for compliance presets, load_rules(file/uri) for custom YAML
All kwargs after url= are forwarded to requests.request() — timeout, verify, headers, params, etc.
Import path: from drheader import Drheader; from drheader.utils import load_rules, preset_rules
